headline: US Managed Care Shares Plunge on Medicare for All Proposal
summary: Shares of UnitedHealth, Humana, and CVS Health declined following the introduction of a new Medicare for All legislative proposal.
why: UnitedHealth Group, Humana, and CVS Health are major commercial health insurers in the United States reliant on private coverage frameworks.

impacts.name: UnitedHealth Group
impacts.why: Shares fell after a new Medicare for All proposal challenged private health insurance business models.
